correctness.rationale: Plancherel with zero extension gives T*T=(1+r²)I+r(S_h+S_h*) for h=2η; neither diagonal term is clipped in the stated codomain. Reindexing the input interval by residue mod h is a unitary map to the sum of L² fiber intervals tensored with finite path spaces. At integral q the only length is q a.e.; at nonintegral q the two listed lengths occur on intervals of the stated positive measures, except the omitted length zero when q<1. Sine diagonalization gives the entire finite spectral list, with each eigenvector tensored with a separable infinite-dimensional L² space. Coprimality of consecutive denominators excludes duplicate cosine fractions, including in the case of only length one. The extrema come from length m and are attained on a set of positive measure. The lower Gram eigenvalue is (1−r)²+2r(1−cos(π/(m+1)))>0. For r=1 the half-angle formulas give the inverse bound, condition number and η↓0 limit, and the ceiling gives the one-sided jump at each exact threshold. The packaged finite checks are not a proof of the fiber or spectral assertions and were inspected, not executed.
